The tool doesn't take a ticket number, so this result is for the SKU, size and vendor only. I haven't looked at anything else in ticket 101. To get the shirts restocked, the $840 invoice has to be paid first. I haven't checked whether paying it is allowed under the store's rules or whether there's enough cash. `check_rent_and_cash` can check the cash side if you want that next.
